# Test first-class edit links in static output.

md2html -html out -html-ext html -edit-url 'https://example.com/edit/{path}' src

exists out/README.html
grep '<a class="edit-link" href="https://example.com/edit/README.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Edit this page</a>' out/README.html

-- src/README.md --
# README

Edit me.
